tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H ≤ 0.48, whereas the target is H = 23.2. The selected probe directly constrains the slow adaptation and discriminates long-horizon reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation term needed for the 23.2 forecast horizon.
Finer short-time observations would not directly resolve the long-horizon reversal.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the temporal mechanism.
